name: 60091 · Wilmette, IL
findings: ZIP 60091 (Wilmette) has 184 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60091 (Wilmette) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 38 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
